title: Art. 9.10 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, B. Advance Passenger Information (API), 9.10
content: When specifying the identifying information on passengers to be transmitted, Contracting States shall require only data elements that are available in machine readable form in travel documents conforming to the specifications contained in Doc 9303. All information required shall conform to specifications for UN/EDIFACT PAXIST messages found in the WCO/IATA/ICAO API Guidelines.
